claims.head: A tough night ahead for Lafferty
claims.call: The Penguins’ P2 (Letang and Stastney) spends at least 33% of its 5-on-5 time against the Panthers’ fourth line.
claims.body: At home, the Penguins keep sending Letang and Stastney out against opponents’ fourth lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Dan Muse has been picking a defense pair for opponents’ fourth lines. Tonight the Panthers’ fourth line is Hathaway, Lafferty and Imama.
claims.nums: At home: 33% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against fourth lines, about 20% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Dan Muse likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Panthers’ fourth line.

claims.head: Forecheck against patience
claims.body: On forecheck pressure, Florida is the league’s best, but Pittsburgh is the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect the Panthers to win more pucks back deep in the Penguins’ end.

notes.text: Aleksander Barkov is on long-term injured reserve (lower-body injury) and has missed the last 6 games. He is one of their best players.
Brad Marchand is on injured reserve (leg injury) and has missed the last 4 games.
Trevor van Riemsdyk is day to day (lower body injury) and has missed the last 3 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Spencer Stastney has taken his spot beside Kris Letang.
Egor Chinakhov is out (lower-body injury) and missed their last game. He is a top-six forward. Ville Koivunen has taken his spot beside Evgeni Malkin and Tommy Novak.
Spencer Stastney joined from EDM on Oct 7 and has played beside Kris Letang.

PIT.head: Leaning the Penguins’ way
PIT.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Pittsburgh has home-ice advantage, while Florida will be without Barkov. The Panthers can still swing it if their penalty kill holds up.

FLA.head: Close, but the Penguins have the slight edge
FLA.body: The two have been about even at out-chancing opponents lately. Pittsburgh has home-ice advantage, while Florida will be without Barkov. The Panthers can tip it if their penalty kill holds up.

story.head: Strength against strength
paras: The Penguins are 3-4-1. The Panthers have won two in a row.

It’s strength against strength: the Penguins are one of the league’s best for chance quality, but the Panthers are near the top at preventing dangerous shots. At home, Dan Muse likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Cats’ fourth line.

items.text: Bokondji Imama faces his old team, Pittsburgh.
Rickard Rakell has a point in six straight games against Florida, with a goal in each of the last three.
The Panthers have been without Aleksander Barkov and Brad Marchand for several games.
The Penguins are newly without Trevor van Riemsdyk and Egor Chinakhov.
